statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. Define A to be the set of all integers m for which there exists an integer l with 0 <= l, m > 1, l + m <= len(nums), and, for every j with 0 <= j < m, nums[l+j] = nums[l] + (j mod 2). If A is empty, then r = -1. If A is not empty, then r = max(A).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2 and len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.
